lines.beaver_en: Could you sum up and report the search results?
lines.en: Yes, I'll sum up the results and tell you.

lines.beaver_en: First, how about the park area?
lines.learner: 공원 뒤 공터와 주변 일대를 모두 살폈습니다.
lines.en: I checked the vacant lot behind the park and the whole surrounding area.
lines.roman: Gongwon dwi gongteowa jubyeon ildaereul modu salpyeotseumnida.

lines.beaver_en: Did you happen to find anything?
lines.learner: 공터 북쪽 모퉁이에서 신발 한 짝을 찾았습니다.
lines.en: I found one shoe at the north corner of the lot.
lines.roman: Gongteo bukjjok motungieseo sinbal han jjageul chajatseumnida.

lines.beaver_en: Is it the child's shoe? Any other traces?
lines.en: Yes, there were footprints at the edge of the wall too.
I checked the back alleys of the market, but nothing.

lines.beaver: 담당자 행방은 어떻습니까? 연락이 안 됩니다.
lines.beaver_en: What about the person in charge? I can't reach him.
lines.beaver_roman: Damdangja haengbangeun eotteoseumnikka? Yeollagi an doemnida.
lines.learner: 담당자 행방은 아직 모릅니다. 계속 찾겠습니다.
lines.en: We still don't know where he is. I'll keep looking.
lines.roman: Damdangja haengbangeun ajik moreumnida. Gyesok chatgetseumnida.

lines.beaver_en: Have you checked all the indoor places?
lines.learner: 실내는 끝났고, 지금은 실외를 보고 있습니다.
lines.en: Indoors is done; now I'm checking outdoors.
lines.roman: Sillaeneun kkeunnatgo, jigeumeun siroereul bogo itseumnida.

lines.beaver_en: Where did you put up the flyers?
lines.en: All around the neighborhood and throughout the market.

lines.beaver_en: Good. Let's put other work on hold for now.
lines.learner: 네, 다른 일은 뒤로 미루고 수색에 집중하겠습니다.
lines.en: Yes, I'll put other things off and focus on the search.
lines.roman: Ne, dareun ireun dwiro mirugo susaege jipjunghagetseumnida.

lines.beaver: 그럼 공터 쪽으로 다시 가 봅시다.
lines.beaver_en: Then let's go back to the vacant lot.
lines.beaver_roman: Geureom gongteo jjogeuro dasi ga bopsida.
lines.en: Okay, I'll start again from the north corner.
